scope.summary: Honor rigidity masks across BOTH projection and simulation per Section 13.24 (REQ-026): garment hardware (buttons, buckles, underwire, zippers) under rigidity masks binds rigidly during auto-follow projection and is treated as rigid clusters by the sim, so hardware survives extreme-body projection undistorted.
acceptance_criteria: Vertices under a garment rigidity mask bind as a rigid unit to their dominant anchor (bone or garment region frame) during MT-587 auto-follow; per-vertex projection is bypassed for masked sets.

The solver treats rigidity-masked clusters as rigid bodies (shape-locked constraint groups) during drape and grow-into-garment refits; cluster shape deviation stays under a typed epsilon through a full archetype-(a) refit.
Mask authority is the garment's existing rigidity data (Cloth 13.8 trims); no duplicate BodyKit-side mask store is introduced.
A bra-with-underwire fixture keeps underwire curvature intact (Hausdorff distance to rest shape under epsilon) across a breast-volume sweep to extreme-large.
scope.risk_if_missed: Garment hardware melts into noodles exactly on the extreme bodies BodyKit exists for, making every fitted garment with trims unusable and silently corrupting export geometry.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
